title: Compute the connected fourth-order interaction with the dressed vacuum retained
statement: For valid isolated-sector fourth-order perturbation of the declared two-spin parity-bath model,delta=eta_plus-eta_minus,C(w)=1/(epsilon^2-w^2),G=int wC ddelta,H=int C^2 ddelta,J=int int C(w)C(v)/(w+v) ddelta(w)ddelta(v),the connected coefficient is C4=8epsilon^2GH-4epsilon^2J. J>=0 by its Laplace-square representation.

requires: Positive-frequency complete parity coupling measures,separated from epsilon
Valid isolated-sector perturbation,regular returning-path denominators and convergent displayed integrals
provides: Reusable fourth-order spectral functional with rotating and counterrotating paths
Exact cancellation of the spurious second-order shift when Eg is included
assumptions: C4 is a coefficient,not an all-orders energy expression
J>=0 does not by itself force C4 positive for arbitrary measures
Physical supports and form factors must actually be supplied
costs: Complete spectral measures and perturbative arithmetic
contract.units: hbar=B=1,source-local energy/time and stated amplitude versus population conventions; no automatic device-unit conversion
contract.obstruction: Omitting Eg or copying the RWA-only kernel changes the interaction.

evidence.range_scope: Connected-energy definition,full returning-path kernel and spectral functional.
Actual independent completed fourth-order path audit with normalization/contact terms.

body: Actual complete source argument and scoped review govern this unit. No physical input,program execution,priority or advantage is acquired by extraction.

review.scope: Read the exact-version review and retained obligations.
